title: Notes
intro: Ideas, checklists and quick reminders, kept with your email on your own Cloudflare account. Only you can see your notes.
introShared: Ideas, checklists and quick reminders, kept with your email on your own Cloudflare account. Only you can see your notes unless you share one with everyone who uses this mailbox.
emptyText: Jot down an idea, start a checklist or set yourself a reminder. Press New note to begin.
binIntro: Deleted notes stay here for 30 days, then go for good.
emptyBinConfirm: Delete everything in the Bin for good? This can't be undone.
deleteForeverConfirm: Delete this note for good? This can't be undone.
remindHint: We'll send a notification to every device that has notifications on for this mailbox. You can turn them on in Settings.
share: Share with everyone who uses this mailbox
shareHint: They can see and change it. Only you can stop sharing it.
sharedYours: Shared with everyone who uses this mailbox
failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
